title: IEC 60870-5-104 StartDT & TestFR Connection Supervision
description: Minimal IEC 104 substation RTU station configuration defining TCP port 2404, APCI flow-control parameters (k=12, w=8, t1=15s, t2=10s), and link supervision status points.
code:
station Sub_Link_RTU ca=101 oa=1 port=2404 k=12 w=8 t1=15 t2=10
point 1001 M_SP_NA_1 Link_StartDT_Active init=1
point 1002 M_SP_NA_1 TestFR_Keepalive_OK init=1
point 2001 M_ME_NC_1 Aux_DC_Bus_V units=V scale=1.0 offset=0.0 deadband=0.5 init=125.0
point 2002 M_ME_NC_1 RTU_Temp_C units=C scale=1.0 offset=0.0 deadband=1.0 init=32.5
